Calendar & counting notes

How your numbers are calculated +

The term runs August 18-December 16, 2026. Regular classes end December 8. Class counts include only your stated weekly meeting times, with university holidays and schedule substitutions applied. Final exams are listed separately and are not counted as regular classes.

September 8 uses Monday’s schedule; November 24 uses Friday’s. No classes on September 7, 11, or 21, October 10-18, or November 25-29. Academic Assessment Days (September 23-27) are not labeled as days off in the academic calendar, so normal meetings remain included.

“Class days left” counts dates with at least one session that has not ended, including today if relevant. “Sessions left” includes in-progress sessions. “Class hours left” counts the remaining duration of those sessions. The departure countdown is pinned to December 17 at 11:00 AM in America/New_York, including the November daylight-saving change.

Individual exams require your syllabus or official course schedule. ACCT 212 is included as home study and adds no attendance days or class hours. This is a calendar-based plan, not an attendance record; instructor-specific cancellations and changes are not included.

Sources checked September 16, 2026: Binghamton academic calendar ↗ · Final exam scheduling ↗
